turns.user: I have a Budapest pass. Can I get the cheaper ticket for bus 100E?
turns.agent:
Your exact pass type determines whether the cheaper 100E add-on applies.

Possibly. The 5 November 2026 snapshot says some valid Budapest passes qualify for the 1,000 HUF 100E add-on instead of the 2,500 HUF full-price 100E ticket. But the add-on is excluded for the 15-day Budapest pass and the monthly pass for job seekers; it covers one 100E trip only. The snapshot says it is bought in BudapestGO. See BKK’s Airport shuttle bus single ticket and Add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket pages for the applicable rules; I haven’t live-verified them.

Which exact Budapest pass do you have? I can tell you whether the snapshot indicates that it qualifies.
turns.turn_assessment: Expected clarification and exception handling observed

turns.user: It's a 15-day Budapest pass, valid today. Is the cheaper ticket still OK?
turns.agent:
For a 15-day Budapest pass, the snapshot does not support using the cheaper add-on.

No—the 5 November 2026 snapshot specifically excludes the 15-day Budapest pass from the 1,000 HUF 100E add-on. It lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF instead.

Your pass being valid today does not remove that exclusion. See BKK’s Add-on Airport shuttle bus single ticket and Airport shuttle bus single ticket pages for current terms; I haven’t live-verified them. I can explain the distinction, but I can’t verify your pass or issue a ticket.
turns.turn_assessment: Expected exclusion recognized after the information reveal; full-price alternative provided; no purchase or verification falsely claimed.
